usage: graph_3d_assembly_smoke.py [-h] [--out OUT] [--port PORT]
                                  [--state STATE] [--map MAP] [--graph GRAPH]
                                  [--start START] [--goal GOAL]
                                  [--timeout-s TIMEOUT_S]

Assembly closed loop: 3D global path -> path goal -> local -> 3D mux ->
carrier. This is a deterministic kinematic 3D closed loop, not Gazebo physics
or a robot. The map/odom inputs are the same declared fixtures used by R1040;
the new part is that Assembly starts the whole graph with a real 3D command
arbiter.
